item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00200","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C15","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.95,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 plausibly supplied a concrete procedural template for the child's treatment of industrial security-clearance applicants. Both directives prescribe a closely parallel adjudicatory sequence: detailed written notice constrained by national-security considerations, a written response, a personal hearing, representation by counsel, presentation of evidence, cross-examination, protection of sensitive information, and a written determination. C15 is also materially relevant because it supplies the distinctive substantive standard that access or employment be “clearly consistent with the interests of the national security,” along with investigation and agency-head adjudication machinery. C11 provides the broader classified-information and access-control framework but is less directly connected to the child's detailed individual procedures.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"A written statement of the reasons why his access authorization may be denied or revoked, which shall be as comprehensive and detailed as the national security permits.","parent_excerpt":"A written statement of the alleged derogatory information, in as much detail as security considerations permit.","explanation":"Distinctive parallel requirement for detailed written notice limited only as necessary to protect national security."},{"child_excerpt":"A reasonable opportunity to reply in writing under oath or affirmation to the statement of reasons.","parent_excerpt":"An opportunity to answer or comment upon the statement of alleged derogatory information, in writing, and to submit affidavits.","explanation":"Both establish a written rebuttal stage following notice."},{"child_excerpt":"An opportunity to appear personally ... to present evidence on his behalf ... [and] to be represented by counsel ... [and] to cross-examine persons.","parent_excerpt":"An opportunity for hearing before the Board ... including the right of the person to be represented by counsel, to present witnesses and other evidence in his behalf, and to cross-examine witnesses.","explanation":"This is a highly specific, materially parallel package of hearing rights and strongly indicates reuse of an adjudicatory template."},{"child_excerpt":"A written notice of the final decision in his case which, if adverse, shall specify whether ... [the decisionmaker] found for or against him with respect to each allegation.","parent_excerpt":"Based upon all the evidence before it ... the Board shall make its determinations in writing, and shall send to each person who is the subject thereof a copy.","explanation":"Both conclude the protected proceeding with a written determination delivered to the affected person."}]}
